race.comment: SANDASTAN (1) sets a clear benchmark on current form, coming back from a metro placing at Morphettville where he was favourite and beaten just over three lengths after looking a winning chance late. His previous win at this track, when he came from well back to win by just under three lengths, reads very well for this and his proven 2050m record puts him on top. CHARTIN (6) is the main threat off a close fourth in a BM68 in Saturday company at Morphettville Parks, with the easier assignment offsetting the weight rise from that latest run. Set for a strong run. THE ICE CUTTER (9) has winning claims after being beaten a neck at this track last start and his wide-run eighth at Gawler two back had more merit than the result suggests. In the mix on best. TAN TAT GOLD (3) is backing up quickly after placing 10 days ago when third at this track, where he was wide throughout and beaten just over a length. His track-and-trip record keeps him right in the contest if he finds more.
